title: [K-Poppin'] "Singlish" Day with DKB(다크비) :Cherish all these memories from 🎵 Get Away🚘
description:
Learn Korean and English on "Singlish" every Monday!
DKB joins us every week to learn a pop song the listeners chose! Penalties await too!
Every Monday from 1-2pm kst don't forget to join in!
 
💚 Today’s Guests: D1(디원), E-CHAN(이찬), 해리준(HARRY JUNE) from DKB(다크비)
💚Today’s Singlish:  Get Away -DKB ❤️ 🔥
